name: Effective Range / Maximum Positive Degree
details: Every edge of the 1-inclusion graph uses an active coordinate.
proof: A smaller neighbor counted by the dominance of a concept differs from it on one coordinate. Such a coordinate is active. Therefore the positive degree of every vertex, and hence its maximum, is at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\).
witness_verification: For the family #classes/halfintervals with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n-1$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
